Markets.title: Average long-term US mortgage rate eases to 7.32% in first pullback since late August
Markets.summary: The average U.S. 30-year fixed mortgage rate fell to 7.32% from 7.42% in the first decline since late August. Although this offers slight relief to homebuyers, elevated borrowing costs continue to weigh on housing demand and sales.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets fell sharply on Thursday, with the Sensex dropping over 460 points and the Nifty declining 124 points. The drop was driven by rising crude oil prices, a weak rupee, and global uncertainties, resulting in a loss of Rs 3 lakh crore in market value.

Markets.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
Markets.summary: Yes Bank plans to skip coupon payments on its additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year despite a Supreme Court ruling that annulled the previous write-off of these securities. Bondholders are demanding repayment based on the court's decision, but the bank maintains it holds ultimate authority over the payments.

Markets.title: Sebi warns investors against WhatsApp stock tips. Here's how you can avoid such traps
Markets.summary: SEBI has warned investors to avoid unauthorized stock tips and fake profit claims shared in exclusive WhatsApp groups. The market regulator advised investors to verify credentials and use only registered intermediaries to protect against these scams.

Markets.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
Markets.summary: Anthropic plans to proceed with its initial public offering next month despite a challenging market environment that has caused other AI companies to delay their listings. While recent market instabilities and the Oura IPO have raised concerns, investors continue to view Anthropic as a leading tech contender.

Geo-Political.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Newborn twins Raghad and Raad are fighting for survival amidst a severe hunger crisis in Yemen. Their family was forced to flee their home on foot due to ongoing fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

Geo-Political.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
Geo-Political.summary: Developers of the PHP programming language discovered critical cybersecurity vulnerabilities in their software. Consequently, affected websites were taken offline as organizations scrambled to update their computer systems.

Geo-Political.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump is suing the BBC regarding a 2021 Panorama episode that edited together two different parts of his speech. A court has now ordered Trump to answer questions under oath as part of this lawsuit.

Geo-Political.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
Geo-Political.summary: A crowd of 50 people beat an unidentified foreigner to death in South Africa. This attack follows a wave of anti-migrant protests in the country this year.

Geo-Political.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
Geo-Political.summary: Germany has experienced an intensive wave of espionage following the arrest of a Ukrainian man suspected of spying for Russia. This incident is one of several similar spy cases uncovered in Germany this year.

Geo-Political.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
Geo-Political.summary: A severe storm in southern France caused flooding that resulted in at least four deaths. The fatalities include two women who drowned inside a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. This recovery was driven by refiners purchasing spot cargoes as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz increased.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers showed differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without harming economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two members of the RBI's monetary policy committee opposed shifting from a neutral stance to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. Meanwhile, all six members unanimously supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement. Meanwhile, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced production contractions during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, surpassing the 3.1% growth recorded in the same month last year. This increase was driven primarily by higher production in the coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore sectors.

India.title: PM Modi Says 'Parasite' Congress Hurts Dissent Movements, 'Honest Critics'
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the Congress party undermines legitimate dissent movements and reform efforts in India. Speaking at the NDTV World Summit 2026, he argued that the party's interference drowns out the voices of honest critics.

India.title: Police Case Over Delhi Influencer's Racist Video Against Tripura Teen
India.summary: Tripura Police filed a case against a Delhi influencer for posting a racist video targeting a Tripura teenager. Delhi Police is cooperating and providing assistance with the ongoing investigation.

India.summary: The Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, an RSS-affiliated group, has opened its first public office in the Kashmir Valley. The organization's Kashmir in-charge, Sameer Kuchay, stated that the Sangh had already established a significant presence in the region prior to this formal opening.

India.title: "UN's Limits Clearly Visible": PM Modi Presses For 'New Solutions' At NDTV Summit
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi stated that the limits of the United Nations and other global institutions are clearly visible in the face of today's challenges. He emphasized the need for new solutions to address these modern challenges as new powers and voices emerge globally.

India.title: Tech CEO-YouTuber Jason Samuel Arrested Over Influencer Harish's Suicide
India.summary: Tech CEO and YouTuber Jason Samuel has been arrested in connection with the suicide of influencer Harish. Police registered a case against Samuel under Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for the abetment of suicide.

India.title: NDTV World Summit 2026 Highlights: "Trade, Technology, Sea Routes, Being Weaponised Today": PM Modi
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi delivered the keynote address at the opening of the NDTV World Summit 2026. During his speech, he stated that trade, technology, and sea routes are currently being weaponized.
